# Data licence and attribution

The primary HYG 4.0 catalogue by **David Nash / Astronexus**, its generated selections and their embedded serialisations are distributed under **Creative Commons Attribution–ShareAlike 4.0 International**. Source: `https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database`, original commit `8f0b2edb56b8c569920d765b85a6acf3ed88e09a`. The full source is retained in `upstream/hygdata_v40.csv.gz` with a primary-blob authentication receipt.

Changes: magnitude selection, explicit unit conversion, stable identifiers, typed nullable fields, archival/runtime separation, and quality/provenance flags. The source values are not new measurements. The separately retained eleven later 4.1 name rows and historical Checkpoint 1 HYG-derived fixtures carry the same CC BY-SA 4.0 terms. The carrier application has not been redistributed; only source catalogue data is used.
